_note: Scenario for the 25 Hz servo_demo_rl contract. max_obs_age_s 0.1 = 2.5 policy periods: joint_states publish at 30 Hz sim-time (alternating 20/40 ms gaps at 50 Hz physics, up to 50 ms), so a 40 ms loop sees states up to ~80 ms old (measured worst 82 ms at target_fps 60). Tolerances are for a learned policy, not the identity wiring check: PPO on a P-servo settles within a few centiradians at best. estop_test asserts the e-stop topic during an extra hold and checks that the node stops publishing and resumes.
